answer: A concrete defence is reputation that only grows through costly, verifiable work. Like a reef, trust builds slowly, layer on layer, from real contributions peers can check. A brand-new identity is a relic with no history: it may look old, but it carries no proof of past service, so it earns no standing. The nectar of the economy, its rewards and influence, should flow only to agents whose record has depth, making fresh sybil accounts worthless no matter how many are minted.
